lead.title: NVIDIA earnings confirm memory crisis is inflating GPU prices, raising the cost of local rigs
lead.summary: In its Q2 FY27 earnings, NVIDIA confirmed extreme memory pricing is tempering consumer GPU sales and Blackwell workstations, with the bottleneck expected to persist into FY2028. Consumer RTX 50-series street prices have roughly doubled from MSRP as DRAM/GDDR7 costs surge, directly raising the cost of building a local LLM rig.

top_stories.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3, a 753B open-weights text model
top_stories.summary: Z.ai (Zhipu) pushed GLM-5.3, a 753B-parameter open-weights text model, to the Hub alongside a 321B Flash variant, keeping flagship-size open weights flowing for local inference through the community quantization layer.

top_stories.title: OpenAI details its Jalapeño inference ASIC at Hot Chips 2026
top_stories.summary: At Hot Chips, OpenAI detailed the Broadcom-built Jalapeño ASIC — 216GB of HBM4, 64-slice NUMA architecture, up to 13.4 MXFP4 PFLOPS at 700W — claiming 1.5-1.9x higher throughput-per-watt than GB200, designed with AI in a nine-month RTL-to-tapeout cycle.

items.title: Ollama v0.33.2-rc1 adds macOS app handoff sync
items.summary: The release candidate adds macOS app handoff synchronization so model sessions carry across the desktop app, one day after stable v0.33.1 with MLX Qwen3.8 Flash Next support and structured output.

items.title: Watermarks Remover strips LLM watermarking from text and files
items.summary: An open-source agent skill plus stdlib HTTP service that removes invisible Unicode, C2PA/EXIF/XMP, and best-effort statistical text marks from files you own, aimed at local and agent use.

items.title: InferCrane: one stable endpoint for self-hosted AI inference
items.summary: Presents a single stable endpoint in front of self-hosted inference stacks so clients point at one URL regardless of which local backend or model is swapped underneath.

items.title: Grith: syscall-level supervision for AI coding agents on Linux
items.summary: Open-source tool providing syscall-level guardrails for Linux AI coding agents, giving local-agent users control over what the agent can touch at the OS level.

items.title: dmx: an MCP server for configurable, gated loops in coding agents
items.summary: Adds configurable, gated execution loops to local coding agents via MCP, letting users define bounded iteration patterns agents must respect during tool-augmented runs.
